# integrity/invalid-suppression

Suppression without a valid reason.

An ubon-ignore comment that names no rule, an unknown rule, or no reason in the form `<who decided>: <evidence>`.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.

## Why it matters

A suppression is a claim that a finding is wrong or accepted. Without a reason nobody can check the claim later, so Ubon ignores the comment and keeps the finding.

## How to fix

Write it as `ubon-ignore <rule>: <who decided>: <evidence>`, or remove it.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore integrity/invalid-suppression: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "integrity/invalid-suppression": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
